europe_now.title: Ukrainian Drone Strikes Hit Russian Vessels
europe_now.summary: Ukrainian forces targeted and struck Russian ships operating in maritime areas off the Libyan coast. President Volodymyr Zelenskyy confirmed the military actions following initial reports from regional officials regarding the attacks.

europe_now.title: Collapse of COP31 Climate Negotiations
europe_now.summary: International climate talks at the COP31 summit have collapsed following a failure among participating nations to reach a consensus. Observers and officials are now assessing the geopolitical and environmental fallout from the stalled negotiations.
